meta.title: JOURNEYWAYS | Home
meta.description: JOURNEYWAYS is a master's research project at UBC GRSJ. A board game and a digital game in development, used as research instruments to study how people self-identify when given a narrative-driven, safe, collaborative play space.
meta.keywords: JOURNEYWAYS, board game, identity exploration, collaborative storytelling, decolonial play, forced migration narrative, gender-diverse storytelling, UBC GRSJ research, transdisciplinary art, transformative identity game, self-discovery game, narrative game, character development, solo board game, group board game
meta.og_description: JOURNEYWAYS is a UBC-rooted research project exploring identity and agency through collaborative storytelling. A secular, gender-neutral tool for forced migrants and gender-diverse individuals to explore selfhood through play.

hero.lead:
You don't play to win; you play to unfold.
You choose, and you uncover.
hero.body: Explore selfhood not with labels, but with stories, memory, and meaning. Whether solo or as part of a group, each session reveals a story made only by your presence.
hero.image_alt: Watercolor of two profiles facing each other; warm tones on the left, cool tones on the right, with a landscape of mountains and water unfolding in the negative space between them. The JOURNEYWAYS visual identity.

cards.title: No Fixed Roles
cards.body: Discover your character through play, not predetermined archetypes. Identity is built at the table, not selected from a list.

cards.title: Collaborative Storytelling
cards.body: Co-create narratives that reveal deeper truths about identity. There is no single narrator; the story belongs to everyone.

cards.title: Continuous Growth
cards.body: Each session builds upon the last, creating an evolving journey. What carries between sessions is the story, not a mechanic.

0.title: No Fixed Roles
0.body: You don't pick from a list of classes, races, or archetypes. You arrive as yourself, or as someone you invent. Realistic, fantastic, simple, or layered are all valid starting points.
0.quote: Identity is built through play, not selected from a list.

1.title: Collaborative Storytelling
1.body: A session unfolds as dialogue. Players tell their own stories and respond to others'. Cards prompt encounters, tiles place you on a shared map, and group cards invite the table to weave threads together.
1.quote: There is no single narrator. The story belongs to everyone at the table.
links: Design philosophy: A mirror in a cave

2.title: Continuous Growth
2.body: Sessions can stand alone, or continue. Players bring a character into a future session, open a chapter two, or pick up where they left off. There is no formal mechanic for continuity. What carries is the story.
2.quote: Solo and group play share the same character. The digital version supports the same migration.
links: Design philosophy: Expression in any modality

gameplay.a_body: Whether you're exploring alone or with friends, JOURNEYWAYS adapts to your preferred style of play. Solo sessions offer deep introspection, while group play creates rich, collaborative narratives.
gameplay.b_body: Every decision in JOURNEYWAYS carries weight. Your choices don't just affect the game; they reveal aspects of yourself you might not have known existed.
